name: geoinsight
description: GeoInsight — 교육적 지리 설명을 위한 시맨틱 DSL → 결정적 SVG 렌더 엔진 (지도를 위한 Mermaid)

scripts.release:patch: pnpm release:check && pnpm --filter @geo-insight/tiptap exec npm version patch && pnpm --filter @geo-insight/tiptap exec npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: pnpm release:check && pnpm --filter @geo-insight/tiptap exec npm version minor && pnpm --filter @geo-insight/tiptap exec npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: pnpm release:check && pnpm --filter @geo-insight/tiptap exec npm version major && pnpm --filter @geo-insight/tiptap exec npm publish && git push --follow-tags
